name: Background research
summary: Between conversations, the agent does read-only work on its own (searching, reading documents, checking feeds) and only interrupts the user with a short nudge when it finds something worth acting on. Any action with side effects waits for the user's approval.
how: A schedule or idle trigger starts a background run
Agent uses read-only tools to gather and summarise information
Agent scores whether the finding is worth an interruption
If so, it sends a brief nudge with a proposed next step
The user approves before anything is changed
facts: Useful initiative with low risk, but spends tokens on research nobody asked for
goodFor: Preparing context before the user asks
watchOut: Notification fatigue if the bar for nudges is low
